d:
Chandramukhi Tamil movie features Rajinikanth, Prabhu, Jyothika, Nayantara, Vadivelu and Nassar. Directed by P Vasu, produced by Ramkumar Ganesan and Prabhu. Music composed by Vidyasagar. Chandramukhi movie also features Vineeth, Malavika, Vijayakumar, K R Vijaya, Sonu Sood among others.
Star Cast : Rajinikanth, Prabhu, Jyothika, Nayantara, Vadivelu, Nassar, Vineeth, Vijayakumar, K R Vijaya, Sonu Sood
Director : P Vasu
Producers : Ramkumar Ganesan, Prabhu
Music : Vidyasagar
Cinematography : Sekhar V Joseph
Editor : Suresh Urs
Release Date : 14 April 2005
